description.en: The instance ID of the certificate application repository.

description.zh: 仓库名称，支持模糊查询。
description.en: The name of the certificate application repository. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh: 分页，每页展示数据大小，默认50。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 50.

description.zh:
仓库类型，取值：

- **uploadCA **：上传的CA证书，即包含完整证书链的CA证书。
- **uploadPCA **：上传的证书，包括自签证书、第三方签发的证书或阿里云签发的证书等。
- **aliyunPCA **：阿里云PCA证书。
description.en:
The type of the certificate application repository. Valid values:

- **ssl**: certificate application repository of SSL certificates

- **uploadPCA**: certificate application repository of uploaded private certificates

- **free**: certificate application repository of free certificates, available only on the China site (aliyun.com)

- **aliyunPCA**: certificate application repository of private certificates purchased from Alibaba Cloud Private Certificate Authority (PCA), available only on the China site (aliyun.com)

- **disable**: disabled certificate application repository

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于查询证书仓库列表。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call the ListCertWarehouse operation to query certificate repositories.

### Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cas list-cert-warehouse --name name --instance-id 14dcc8afc7578e1f --type aliyunPCA --current-page 1 --show-size 50 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cas ListCertWarehouse --region cn-hangzhou --Type aliyunPCA --InstanceId 14dcc8afc7578e1f --CurrentPage 1 --ShowSize 50 --Name name
